cues.text: Steep, jagged mountains of pale grey rock rise from a lush green valley.
Dark pine trees cling to the sheer cliffs. In the foreground, a waterfall tumbles over a rocky ledge.
Below, a wide river winds through the misty valley. The sky warms to a golden sunrise at the horizon.
High above, the colony ship descends on a long trail of white light, heading for the distant plains.

beats.note: Jagged, pale grey mountains rise from a lush valley under a bright blue sky.
A waterfall flows over a rocky ledge in the foreground, with dark pine trees clinging to the sheer cliffs.
A wide river winds through the valley floor, reflecting the sky. Low mist clings to the base of the mountains. The horizon glows with a golden sunrise.
A bright streak of light, the colony ship, descends across the sky toward the distant horizon.
